title: Content Handoff
description: Structured handoff from Content Writer to editor, SEO Analyst, or publisher upon completing an article, post, or content piece. Consumed by SEO Analyst (for post-draft audit), Reviewer (for editorial check), and the publishing workflow. Pairs with seo-metadata.json for final publication metadata.

site.description: Target site slug (e.g. leaseinvietnam, maylanhtreotuong, vesviet, learn).

content_path.description: Repo-relative path(s) to the content file(s) created or updated.

status.description: Content status at time of handoff.

primary_keyword.description: Primary SEO keyword targeted by this content.

word_count.description: Approximate word count of the content body (excluding frontmatter).

editorial_passes.description: Number of editorial passes completed before this handoff.

research_sources.description: Sources used in the content. Can be URLs, document names, or data references.

unverified_claims.description: Claims that could not be fully verified and may need fact-checking.

information_gain.description: How this content adds unique value vs existing content on the topic.

internal_links_added.description: Internal page paths linked from this content.

answer_first_implemented.description: Whether Answer-First (direct answer in first paragraph) structure was applied.

faq_implemented.description: Whether an FAQ section was included.

open_questions.description: Open editorial or fact-checking questions for the next reviewer.

recommended_next_roles.description: Roles that should act on this content next.

source_data.description: Reference to any research-report.json, seo-content-brief.json, or other structured input used.

examples.primary_keyword: thuê nhà ở Việt Nam hướng dẫn
examples.information_gain: First-person checklist format covering legal documents required by foreign nationals — not covered by competing posts
